method.threshold: No performance pass/fail cutoff. Original mobile goal 30FPS is a comparison only; these are desktop Chrome CSS viewports.

productionLanding.qualification: Actual production index build, unauthenticated/no backend; not authenticated world startup

coldNetwork.qualification: Fresh browser context/CDP-limited actual static JS/art fetches; Auth/HTTP/C05 remain synthetic and are not throttled server traffic

limits: Synthetic Auth/HTTP/C05/source qualification, six fixture entities; not live/production admission
Desktop headless Chrome viewport results do not establish mid-range mobile-device 30FPS
JS heap/DOM counters exclude complete process, GPU and native memory
Finite delayed ACK consumer and three serial reconnects are not a server reconnect storm or capacity ceiling
Real 200 sockets/four rooms and operator-selected production caps NOT_RUN
